snippet.title: Far Far West - Frostburn Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Howdy y'all!!

The Frostburn update for Far Far West is available NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124540/Far_Far_West/

Frostburn introduces a new playable map, melee weapons, ice magic and more! Check out the full details for the update here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3124540/view/716788020075824588

ALSO Far Far West is 20% off for TWO WEEKS from TODAY!!!!! So if you or your pals have been waiting for some new content or a sweet discount to ride into the west, FROSTBURN is for y’all!

🤠 Join the Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/farfarwest
🤠 Follow our Socials: https://linktr.ee/FarFarWest

See y'all out there, cowboys. 🧊🌋
